label: West & central plains
hint: Central Thai with the western 'Noe' accent
notes: The western central plains (e.g. Suphan Buri) are known for the drawn-out 'เหน่อ' accent; vocabulary is essentially Central Thai — accent only.
accentHint: Speak Thai with the western central-plains accent (the 'Noe' accent of Suphan Buri): lightly drawn-out vowels and a distinctive lilt.
